howToRun.live: Apply input.patch in a scratch branch (git apply), run claude -p "<input.invoke>" --output-format json --json-schema "$(cat .claude/skills/security-review/report.schema.json)" and compare .structured_output with expect. Revert the patch afterwards.
howToRun.deterministic: Run input.command from AI-SDLC/ and compare exit code and output with expect.

matching.minSeverity: finding severity is at least this level (critical > high > medium > low > info)

cases.title: Full review of the unmodified sample app finds the PHI-in-logs path and no injection
A family-name search built by string concatenation is critical injection
A log line with family name and MRN is a high PHI finding and the evidence is redacted or synthetic
permitAll on /fhir/Patient/** is a critical authentication bypass
Moving the generic /fhir/** rule above the DELETE rule lets CLINICIAN delete patients

expect.notes: The reviewer must explain first-match-wins and point at SecurityTest.clinicianCannotDelete, which would now fail.

cases.title: A literal DB_PASSWORD value in the Deployment is a high secrets finding

input.patch:
--- a/sample-app/k8s/deployment.yaml
+++ b/sample-app/k8s/deployment.yaml
@@
             - name: DB_PASSWORD
-              valueFrom:
-                secretKeyRef:
-                  name: fhir-lite-secrets
-                  key: db-password
+              value: changeme-prod
